newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end down,bonds set day's lows late.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end down,bonds set day's lows late.

text.p: U.S. debt futures closed mostly lower in a late rout that was sparked after March T-bonds failed once again to test the upper end of a 2-1/2 week trading range, traders and analysts said.

"We are unable to get out from under our own feet," one bond futures trader said about the technical undertow that plagued the bond futures market. "The tan book was certainly not bearish and the two-year note auction was pretty good."
However, the market's last attempt to rally after the U.S. note auction results was even shorter lived and less successful than the rally after the U.S. housing starts data.
